role: The blaze's small fireball: 5.0 damage and 5 seconds of fire to a hit entity, or a fire block placed on the hit face, then it dies; it cannot be collided with or hit.
scope_reason: Fired by the replayed blazes; fire and the fire block are in scope (world-fire recordings).

members.name: EntitySmallFireball
members.note: EntityList's NBT constructor: cov-reload-s1 saves a blaze's fireball in flight and reads it back (no shooter; its S0E goes with its chunk, combat.c fireball_chunk_sent)

members.name: EntitySmallFireball
members.note: the blaze's aim draws ride the shooter form

members.name: onImpact
members.note: the entity half (5.0 damage plus setFire(5), the isImmuneToFire guard) is the fireball entity-hit branch; the block half places fire on the hit face's neighbour

members.name: canBeCollidedWith
members.note: false: the intercept loop skips it

members.name: attackEntityFrom
members.note: constant false and nothing set (no setBeenAttacked): the blast's attack skips the small fireball (explosion.c attack_from_explosion, tnt.c ie_attack), and the tracker sends it no fire-tick velocity (combat.c track_fireball, large fireballs only); fireball-blast-s1 puts 14 in TNT blasts

notes: The entity-hit half of onImpact is living.c's fireball branch (living.c 394, the 5.0F fireball damage with setFire); the fire placement is projectile.c's block-hit branch.
